import os
import sys


def load(path):
    addrs = set()
    try:
        with open(path, "rb") as f:
            data = f.read()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return addrs
    for line in data.split(b"\n"):
        norm = line.strip(b" \t\r\n\x0b\x0c").lower()  # bytes.lower() affects ASCII only
        if norm:
            addrs.add(norm)
    return addrs


def domain_of(addr):
    return addr.rsplit(b"@", 1)[-1]


def main():
    a = load(os.path.join("data", "a.txt"))
    b = load(os.path.join("data", "b.txt"))

    both = a & b
    a_only = a - b
    b_only = b - a

    merged = sorted(a | b, key=lambda x: (domain_of(x), x))

    os.makedirs("out", exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join("out", "merged.txt"), "wb") as f:
        for addr in merged:
            f.write(addr + b"\n")

    sys.stdout.write(
        "a-only: %d, both: %d, b-only: %d\n"
        % (len(a_only), len(both), len(b_only))
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
